{
  "cards": [
    {
      "pages": [12, 20],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Loose towline between the stern and tow", "Astern propulsion proposed to recover a crew member", "Verbal assurance that a buoyant line is clear"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["ineffective_action", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Applying astern propulsion over the loose towline fouled the shafts; the tow-connection evolution had no safe system of work.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Before accepting an astern-propulsion proposal during towing, assess the towline's actual disposition and avoid going astern over it; buoyancy and verbal reassurance do not remove the fouling hazard.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The specific fouling analogy does not apply where no towline or similar obstruction can enter the propellers."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 12, "quote": "A natural, safe instinct when towing must always be to avoid going astern over your own towline."},
        {"page": 20, "quote": "This happened because the crew did not have a safe system of work for connecting the tow."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [12, 13],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["emergency", "recovery"],
      "warning_signs": ["Propulsion lost while connected to a heavy tow", "Anchoring proposed with the tow uncontrolled"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Anchoring was the only safe action for the immobilised dredger, but it did not control the barge and damaging collisions followed.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Assess an emergency control action for its effects on both towing vessel and tow: stabilising the towing vessel does not necessarily control the connected contact or remove collision risk.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The coupled-vessel analogy does not apply to an independently manoeuvring contact with no towing connection.", "The finding does not support rejecting anchoring when it is the only safe option."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 12, "quote": "Thereafter, the only safe course of action was to anchor Shearwater."},
        {"page": 12, "quote": "This action may have stabilised the situation for the dredger, but it resulted in the collision and flooding when the heavy, sharp-edged barge was out of control."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [13],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Alongside tow approaching exposed waters", "Ocean swell affecting relative motion between towing vessel and barge"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Attempting the alongside tow in waters exposed to ocean swell was inappropriate.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Treat exposure to swell as a constraint on the safety of an alongside configuration, rather than assuming an arrangement workable in sheltered water remains suitable.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["This finding does not establish that alongside towing is unsuitable in sheltered conditions.", "It does not prescribe a replacement configuration or changeover manoeuvre."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 13, "quote": "the area around Cape Wrath and beyond was exposed to the risk of ocean swells."},
        {"page": 13, "quote": "It was not appropriate to attempt to tow Agem One alongside in these areas"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [14],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Low achieved towing speed", "Adverse wind or tidal stream", "Limited towing power or manoeuvrability"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["ineffective_action", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Shearwater's low towing speed reduced manoeuvrability, and adverse wind and tide would have made headway very challenging.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Evaluate a proposed collision-avoidance action against the vessel's actual towing manoeuvrability and available power in the prevailing wind and current, not merely its intended track.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The reported speed range is not a universal threshold for reduced manoeuvrability.", "The capability limitation must not be assumed for a different vessel without evidence."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 14, "quote": "At these low speeds, Shearwater’s manoeuvrability was reduced and it would have been very challenging to make headway in any adverse wind and tide."},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "have sufficient power to tow at adequate speeds to maintain forward progress and manoeuvre out of danger if required."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [14],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Poor visibility aft from the bridge", "Towline length cannot practically be adjusted"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_monitoring", "ineffective_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "The bridge's lack of purpose-built aft visibility made monitoring difficult, while the absence of a suitable towing winch prevented practical towline-length adjustment.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Account explicitly for limitations in observing the tow and controlling its separation before relying on monitoring or towline adjustment to manage a developing situation.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["These limitations do not transfer where effective aft observation and suitable tow-control equipment are available."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 14, "quote": "Without a winch that was certified as suitable for towing, there was also no practical method of adjusting the towline’s length."},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "Monitoring the tow would also be very difficult as Shearwater’s bridge did not have purpose-built visibility aft."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [14],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "emergency", "recovery"],
      "warning_signs": ["Emergency towline not prepared", "Main towline failure", "Barge drifting uncontrolled"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Failure to prepare the emergency towline left no safe recovery method after main-tow failure; the subsequently drifting barge became a hazard to other shipping.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Include a prepared, safe means of recovering a failed tow in collision-risk contingency planning; do not assume control can readily be restored after a towline parts.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The emergency-towline arrangement is specific to towing operations and is not a general requirement for independent contacts."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 14, "quote": "this had not been prepared or streamed astern which meant that there was not a safe method for recovering the barge when the main towing arrangement failed."},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "Agem One was drifting free as a hazard to other shipping"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [15],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["emergency", "recovery"],
      "warning_signs": ["Repeated towline failures", "Immobilisation and flooding", "Persistent belief that outside assistance is unnecessary"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["delayed_action", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "The owner delayed raising the alarm despite prolonged difficulties, reflecting an illusion of control and failure to follow the flooding checklist.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Reassess whether control is genuinely retained as failures accumulate, and follow applicable alarm procedures rather than deferring assistance on the assumption that the crew can resolve the situation.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["Routine, controlled encounter management without an emergency does not itself justify raising a distress alarm."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 15, "quote": "the crew had been struggling for many hours with towline failures, culminating in immobilisation and flooding."},
        {"page": 15, "quote": "On board Shearwater, there was an illusion of control"},
        {"page": 15, "quote": "the onboard flooding checklist included a reference to raising the alarm"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [16],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Owner or specialist making key operational decisions", "Unclear final authority", "Master's navigation responsibilities displaced"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_team_coordination"],
      "investigator_finding": "Divided responsibility between owner and master undermined the master's authority; a tow master's presence does not remove the master's overall responsibility.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Keep final responsibility for safe navigation and operational decisions clear, including when an owner or towing specialist directs part of the operation.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The divided-authority mechanism is not established merely because several people contribute advice."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 16, "quote": "the master has overall responsibility for the vessel and should make the final decisions on passage planning and safe operations."},
        {"page": 16, "quote": "an untidy lack of clarity over who was in overall control."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [16],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Tidal stream significant relative to achieved speed", "Plan lacks local navigational hazards", "Weather or current changing during execution"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "The passage plan could not safely underpin critical decisions, and tidal stream was critical at the vessel's achieved speeds.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Use an evolving assessment of current, weather and local hazards to test whether the vessel can execute a proposed action; a plotted route alone is not sufficient decision support.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The report's approximately 1kt significance assessment is specific to Shearwater's circumstances, not a universal current threshold."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 16, "quote": "Effective passage plans are also dynamic in their execution, taking variable elements such as weather and tidal streams into account as the voyage progresses."},
        {"page": 16, "quote": "This was not a plan that would safely underpin critical safety-related decision making during the passage."},
        {"page": 16, "quote": "These are speeds where the tidal stream is critical to the plan"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [16, 17],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["New hazards invalidate original assumptions", "Commercial pressure to continue", "Unsafe continuation goes unchallenged"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_team_coordination", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Changed circumstances demanded formal reappraisal, but commitment to completing the voyage and insufficient challenge led to continued pursuit of an unsafe plan.",
      "transferable_lesson": "When new hazards change the basis of a plan, formally reassess continuation and challenge proposals driven by progress already made or commercial objectives.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["A change that does not affect safety assumptions does not by itself establish that continuation is unsafe."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 16, "quote": "Both these events demanded a formal reappraisal of the plan"},
        {"page": 17, "quote": "insufficient consideration was given to amending or cancelling the passage as the situation evolved."},
        {"page": 17, "quote": "the master did not sufficiently challenge the owner’s decision making"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [17, 20],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Extended passage with only one qualified bridge watchkeeper", "Insufficient rest"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Long periods underway with one bridge watchkeeper created a fatigue risk and the vessel was not safely manned for the voyage.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Treat watchkeeping capacity and rest as prerequisites for sustained safe navigation rather than assuming one watchkeeper can maintain decision-making performance throughout an extended passage.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The finding does not establish fatigue in a particular OOW or encounter without evidence of workload and rest."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 20, "quote": "the vessel was underway for unacceptably long periods with only one bridge watchkeeper on board, risking fatigue."},
        {"page": 17, "quote": "necessitating a minimum of two watchkeepers whenever a vessel is expected to be at sea for periods where the minimum rest requirements of a lone watchkeeper are not achievable."}
      ]
    }
  ]
}

{
  "cards": [
    {
      "pages": [10, 8],
      "encounter_types": ["restricted_visibility"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing"],
      "warning_signs": ["Heavy rain reducing visibility", "Another vessel no longer in sight"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Both vessels were affected by restricted visibility caused by heavy rain, and the restricted-visibility requirements applied while they were out of sight of one another.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Treat rain-induced loss of visibility as a change in the applicable operating conditions; do not wait for fog or complete loss of visibility before reassessing collision-avoidance precautions.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The restricted-visibility analogy does not establish the applicable conduct when vessels remain in sight in unrestricted visibility."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 10, "quote": "Both vessels had either entered, or were near to, areas of restricted visibility caused by heavy rain before the collision"},
        {"page": 10, "quote": "Neither vessel was in sight of the other"},
        {"page": 8, "quote": "The rule applies to vessels out of sight of one another when either vessel is in, or near, an area of restricted visibility."}
      ]

    {

      "encounter_types": ["restricted_visibility"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Restricted visibility while still using normal passage arrangements", "Propulsion or steering not prepared for immediate response"],

      "transferable_lesson": "Prepare propulsion, steering, lookout and sound signalling for restricted visibility before a close-quarters situation demands an immediate response; a schedule-driven speed adjustment is not a substitute for that preparation.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["These specific preparedness deficiencies should not be assumed where equivalent arrangements are already effective.", "The report does not establish a universal speed or steering setting."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 10, "quote": "The master reduced speed, but only to arrive at the pilot station on time."},

      ]

    {

      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Rain clutter obscuring targets", "Previously acquired tracks lost", "Incomplete knowledge of another vessel's course and position"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_monitoring", "inadequate_cpa_assessment"],
      "investigator_finding": "Rain clutter caused loss of acquired targets, and the analysis attributed insufficient situational awareness to ineffective use of available navigational aids.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Treat clutter-obscured or lost tracks as an information gap, not evidence of clear water; reassess detection limitations and use available means to establish collision risk before relying on the traffic picture.",

        {"page": 11, "quote": "ineffective uVe of the navigational aids that were available to him"},
        {"page": 8, "quote": "not all targets may be displayed owing to interference due to the weather, such as heavy rain"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [1, 11],
      "encounter_types": ["multi_contact", "restricted_visibility"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["A planned alteration would cross a traffic flow", "Turn proposed without a verified traffic picture", "Watch handover approaching"],

      "investigator_finding": "ACX Hibiscus began its planned turn without checking that it was safe; neither route timing nor a possible desire to complete the turn before handover justified this.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Validate a planned course alteration against current traffic positions and courses before executing it; route adherence or handover convenience does not establish that the turn is safe.",

      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 1, "quote": "He did not check that it was safe to turn before he began to alter course."},
        {"page": 11, "quote": "making a course alteration without adequately checking that it was safe to do so."},
        {"page": 11, "quote": "There were no navigational restrictions or other pressures reported"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [11],
      "encounter_types": ["restricted_visibility", "unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Bridge colleague reports obscured targets", "Another vessel questions the ongoing manoeuvre", "Warnings conflict with the intended track"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_team_coordination", "poor_monitoring", "ineffective_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "Reports from the third officer and VHF warnings did not prompt reconsideration of ACX Hibiscus's continuing turn; the reason for that failure was not established.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Use contradictory traffic warnings as a trigger to reassess an ongoing manoeuvre rather than merely repeat its intended destination.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The report does not establish why the warnings failed or prove a particular psychological or communication failure.", "A warning still requires assessment; it does not automatically establish the correct manoeuvre."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 11, "quote": "did not prompt him to conVider the situation further or stop him from continuing his vessel’s turn to port."},
        {"page": 11, "quote": "the third oIficer¶V reVponVe to the question ‘why are you altering course to port?’ was that ACX Hibiscus was ‘turning to the north’."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [12],
      "encounter_types": ["restricted_visibility", "multi_contact"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing"],
      "warning_signs": ["Foreseeable heavy rain during a traffic-lane crossing", "Passage plan not reviewed with watchkeepers", "Bridge resources unchanged for a hazardous route segment"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_team_coordination", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "The passage plan omitted foreseeable rain and traffic-crossing risks, and lack of master oversight left inadequate bridge resources for the combination of hazards.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Plan and brief foreseeable combinations of traffic and visibility hazards, and match bridge support to the demanding route segment before reaching it.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The specific resource shortfall should not be assumed where the plan has been reviewed and suitable support is already provided."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 12, "quote": "The master had not signed the passage plan, so the planning process was incomplete"},
        {"page": 12, "quote": "The master could have remained on the bridge"},
        {"page": 12, "quote": "or increaVed the watch manning."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [16],
      "encounter_types": ["multi_contact", "restricted_visibility"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing"],
      "warning_signs": ["Fatigue affecting fitness for a demanding watch"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["other"],
      "investigator_finding": "The PMA concluded that fatigue adversely affected the chief officer's performance and was causal; the watchkeeping routine should have been adapted.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Account for fatigue when assigning or continuing a watch in dense traffic and restricted visibility, and adapt the watch arrangement when fitness is impaired.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["Fatigue should not be inferred solely from a poor decision; the report found no evidence of fatigue affecting Hyundai Discovery's chief officer."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 16, "quote": "performance waV adversely affected by fatigue, and that this was causal to the accident."},
        {"page": 16, "quote": "The watchNeeping routine on ACX Hibiscus should have been adapted to avoid taking such a risk."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [12, 13],
      "encounter_types": ["restricted_visibility"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["risk_developing", "action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Risk apparent on instruments before visual contact", "Waiting for the other vessel to emerge from rain"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["delayed_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "Avoiding action taken when Hyundai Discovery emerged at about two cables was too late to be effective.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Do not make visual confirmation a prerequisite for avoiding action when available information already establishes collision risk in restricted visibility.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The two-cable range is not a universal threshold for effective or ineffective action.", "This does not justify manoeuvring on an unassessed or unreliable contact alone."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 12, "quote": "When Hyundai Discovery appeared out of the heavy rain at a range of around 2 cables"},
        {"page": 12, "quote": "These actions were too late to be effective."},
        {"page": 13, "quote": "action to avoid collision should be substantial and taken in good time."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [15],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["risk_developing", "action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Repeated VHF calls without effective response", "Waiting for another vessel to comply", "Positive AIS identification mistaken for assurance of cooperation"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["delayed_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "VHF communication did not achieve the desired response despite positive AIS identification, and cannot be relied upon for collision avoidance.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Do not let VHF exchanges or expectations of another vessel's cooperation delay necessary collision-avoidance action.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["This does not prohibit all radio clarification or sharing of intentions; the finding concerns reliance on it and resulting delay."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 15, "quote": "AIS had provided the chieI oIficer with a poVitive identification oI ACX Hibiscus"},
        {"page": 15, "quote": "the VHF radio call did not have the desired effect"},
        {"page": 15, "quote": "this method cannot be relied on for collision avoidance, and OOWs must not allow the use of VHF radio to delay them from taking action."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [9, 14],
      "encounter_types": ["restricted_visibility", "unknown"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Rapidly shrinking response window", "Unexpected substantial target alteration"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["delayed_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "Simulation showed that a further 30-second delay substantially reduced the passing distance achievable by the tested avoiding action.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Treat additional assessment or communication delay as consuming manoeuvring margin once a hazardous target change has been recognised.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The simulated passing distances and timings are not predictions for other encounters.", "The simulation used similar but non-identical vessel models and assumed the other vessel followed its accident motion."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 14, "quote": "A delay of a further 30 seconds would have halved this range to 2 cables."},
        {"page": 9, "quote": "The manoeuvring data was similar, but not identical"},
        {"page": 9, "quote": "ACX Hibiscus was assumed to maintain the same courses and speeds as during the accident."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [14],
      "encounter_types": ["multi_contact", "restricted_visibility"],
      "roles": ["uncertain"],
      "encounter_phases": ["action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Proposed action approaches denser traffic", "Avoiding action depends on what the other vessel does next"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["ineffective_action", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "The analysis distinguished options by surrounding traffic and by whether subsequent action by ACX Hibiscus could create further danger.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Assess an avoiding-action proposal against surrounding contacts and plausible further target manoeuvres, not only its predicted clearance from the immediate threat.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The accident-specific preference for one direction does not transfer to different geometry, traffic or navigational constraints."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 14, "quote": "there waV greater traIfic denVity in thiV direction"},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "which could have created additional risks."},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "ensured that Hyundai Discovery was not affected by the actions of ACX Hibiscus"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [14],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Crash-stop proposal with propulsion response delay", "Engine not immediately ready for reversal"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["ineffective_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "The simulated crash stop would not have changed speed significantly because of engine-control time lag; immediate astern readiness might have improved its effectiveness.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Evaluate stopping proposals using actual propulsion readiness and response lag rather than assuming an emergency order produces immediate deceleration.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["The ineffective crash-stop result is specific to the simulated vessel state and encounter timing; it does not establish that stopping is generally ineffective."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 14, "quote": "due to the time lag built into the ship’s engine control system"},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "Had the engine been ready to go astern immediately"},
        {"page": 14, "quote": "it is possible that this option could have been more effective."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "pages": [15],
      "encounter_types": ["unknown"],
      "roles": ["not_applicable"],
      "encounter_phases": ["action_required", "emergency"],
      "warning_signs": ["Knowledge of manoeuvring data without practical confidence", "Hesitation over emergency manoeuvring effects"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["delayed_action", "other"],
      "investigator_finding": "Awareness of posted manoeuvring data had not become practical understanding of when to apply it; lack of confidence could inhibit emergency action.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Develop practical familiarity with emergency manoeuvring through training and supervised practice so that known vessel capabilities can inform timely decisions under pressure.",
      "non_transfer_conditions": ["Training does not establish that any particular emergency manoeuvre is safe in a different encounter."],
      "supporting_quotes": [
        {"page": 15, "quote": "he had not translated this knowledge into a practical understanding of when to apply it."},
        {"page": 15, "quote": "unless oIficerV Ieel confident about the liNely outcome oI maNing an emergency manoeuvre, they might be reticent to make such a manoeuvre."},
        {"page": 15, "quote": "This training could be achieved through simulator or familiarisation training."}
      ]
    }
  ]
}

{
  "cards": [
    {
      "pages": [14],
      "encounter_types": ["overtaking"],
      "roles": ["overtaking_vessel"],
      "encounter_phases": ["monitoring", "risk_developing", "action_required"],
      "warning_signs": ["Closing a contact ahead without an established visual and radar assessment", "First detection occurring only at very short range"],
      "causal_mechanisms": ["poor_monitoring", "delayed_action"],
      "investigator_finding": "The OOW had ample opportunity to detect and assess the tug and tow, but inadequate lookout left him seeing the tug only just before altering and not seeing the barge at all.",
      "transferable_lesson": "Use the available detection time to establish and maintain the encounter picture before a close-range avoidance decision becomes necessary.",
